_comment: Curated overlay merged onto OSM data by normalized name match. price: 1=$ cheap … 4=$$$$. verdict: pick|ok|treat (go-to / fine / occasional). verified: facts confirmed in person or from primary sources, with date.

reveille coffee co.notes: Default morning office; closes 4pm. Picks: Tahini Squash Bowl (lunch, 11:15+), Breakfast Bowl (all day). The burrito comes with tater tots; the acai and granola bowls run sweet. Add-ons: +1 egg $2.50; the avocado add-on is redundant on the bowls.

cavalli cafe.notes: Two floors, 2nd floor good for relaxed work; open late (Mon 10pm, Tue-Sun ~11pm) when most cafes here close by 4. Decaf lattes. Food is comfort Italian (panini, cannoli); the tuna sandwich is the most substantial. DPH: Conditional Pass on 2025-08-05 with 8 violations (2016-19 score 96); check the current placard.

comptons coffe house.notes: Backup office: free fast wifi, outlet bar under counter, ~6 solo tables; tight at peak, go early. Apple Pay unverified.

caffe trieste.notes: CASH-LEANING. Oldest espresso bar on the West Coast (1956). Weekend cappuccino spot, culturally analog — not an office. Open late (~10pm).

caffe greco.notes: CASH ONLY (verified in person). Open until ~11pm — the evening decaf-latte spot once you carry cash. Joe-app mobile ordering listing is stale.

molinari delicatessen.notes: 100-year-old deli next door to 371 Columbus. Custom Sandwich $19.25 (verified 8/31): oven roasted turkey, soft roll, lettuce, tomatoes, mustard, no cheese; sweet bell peppers +$1. Online pickup orders 9am-5:10pm. Cured-meat specials are the splurge. Closed Sundays.

trader joes.notes: Staples HQ, open to 9pm; has a parking lot. Zero-cook dinner: Just Grilled Chicken Strips + salad kit + avocado (~$8); steamed lentils; tofu spring rolls (fresh, not fried; appetizer-sized); pre-peeled boiled eggs; Greek yogurt; frozen meals as the backup.

lukes local grocery.notes: 2 min walk, 8am-9pm. Quality tier but pricey (deli plates ~$16, $11 small burrito, verified). Role: emergency ingredients + a prepared dinner when the TJ's window is missed, not staples or everyday lunch. Real butcher counter.

wok shop.notes: Buy the 6-qt stockpot here (sous vide bath + soup pot). Cheap restaurant-grade kitchenware.

golden boy pizza.notes: Legendary focaccia squares. A treat rather than a weeknight default.

vital tea leaf.notes: Free try-before-you-buy tasting bar, ~300 teas (ask for Uncle Gee). Loose-leaf green works out to ~$0.30/cup at home.

gourmet delight bbq.notes: Mixed record: 2019 numeric score 79 (6 violations incl. high-risk temperature holding) and recent reviews citing cleanliness, but the latest SF DPH inspection (2026-02-19) is a Pass with 0 violations. Kam Po (Pass 2025-09, 0 violations) is the steadier pick for roast meat.

kam po kitchen.notes: Best-known roast-meat shop in the neighborhood (Broadway at Powell), 4.8/5 on ~1,400 reviews, famous roast duck. Last inspection on record 88 (2018). Cash only. Order: two-item plate, roast duck + white-cut chicken, extra choy sum, sauce on the side. Crispy pork belly is the indulgent option.

hons wun tun house.notes: Wonton noodle soup, one block from Betty Ann Ong. The lighter option on this stretch. Cash. Last inspection on record: 100, zero violations (2018).

extras.name: Grocery Outlet
extras.notes: Opened Aug 2026 in the old Safeway space, across from Trader Joe's. Deep-discount pantry staples; stock rotates. Not yet in OSM.

extras.name: Fiddle Fig Cafe
extras.notes: Roomy, plant-filled, laptop-normal. Wifi (ask at the counter), outlets, sunny corner + sidewalk seats. Good breakfast burrito. Not yet in OSM.

extras.name: Stockton St produce stalls
extras.notes: Cheapest produce in SF; several stalls, treat as one corridor. Mostly cash — bring small bills. Google Translate camera mode for labels.
